facts.fact: The president of the Autorité de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel, Mohamed Lamine Ould Sidi, met the social security fund's director general on 4 March 2025.
The 4 March 2025 meeting covered applying the provisions of law 2017-020 on personal data protection.

note: No registration, guidance or decision is stated; a partnership proposal is only agreed.
